name: Grid
description: Two-dimensional grid with a fixed gap. Column modifiers collapse to one column below 768px.

values.name: responsive
values.description: As many 280px-minimum columns as fit; no breakpoint needed.

whenToUse: Card collections of unknown length: l-grid--responsive fits as many columns as there is room for.
Dashboards with a fixed number of equal columns: l-grid--2-col, --3-col or --4-col.
whenNotToUse: A main area with a narrower side column: use `l-sidebar`.
A row of equal items that should all stack at once: use `l-switcher`.
use: Prefer l-grid--responsive for card collections of unknown length.
avoid: Adding margins to grid children; the gap already spaces them.

do.text: Keep the source order the same as the visual order.
